edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner during construction.
Constructor initializes the owner state variable.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the update guard.
owner must equal the caller for UpdateNumPlayers to proceed.
UpdateNumPlayers performs the privileged MaxPlayers write.
The num parameter is written into MaxPlayers after bounds validation.
MaxPlayers storage is updated by the privileged write.
msg.sender is the caller of the payable fallback entry point.
The fallback executes the players.push operation.
msg.sender is the element pushed into the players array.
The players array length is read by the fallback.
Fallback adds msg.value to jackpot with unchecked arithmetic.
jackpot is read and increased by msg.value.
The increased value is stored back into jackpot.
players.length is compared against MaxPlayers to trigger the draw.
The fallback routes into RandomWinner, which releases ether to an external address.
MaxPlayers is the threshold checked at the beginning of RandomWinner.
random() computes the keccak256 seed expression.
block.timestamp (now) is used as PRNG entropy, a timestamp dependency.
msg.sender is mixed into the PRNG seed.
The players array is used as PRNG entropy.
random() result depends on block.timestamp (now).
random() depends on msg.sender as entropy.
The predictable PRNG output selects the winner index.
The winner address is indexed out of the players array.
The newly selected winner becomes the recipient of the external transfer.
lastWinner is the recipient of the ether transfer.
RandomWinner performs an external transfer before clearing any state.
RandomWinner performs a second external transfer to the owner before clearing state.
owner is the recipient of the fee transfer.
jackpot is reset only after the external transfer has been made.
The players array is deleted only after the external transfer.
completedGames is incremented only after the external transfer.
RandomWinner computes the fee from the contract balance.
The fee division is delegated to SafeMath.div.
The division result is stored in the local fee variable.
fee is subtracted from the amount sent to the winner.
fee is the amount forwarded to the owner.
The selected player overwrites the lastWinner state variable.
RandomWinner ends with an unchecked completedGames increment.
completedGames is read and incremented without SafeMath.
The players array is emptied by delete.
getPlayers returns the players array to the caller.
First operand flows into SafeMath.mul.
Second operand flows into SafeMath.mul.

Numerator flows into SafeMath.div.
Denominator flows into SafeMath.div.
Minuend flows into SafeMath.sub.

normalization_plan.reason: The num parameter only feeds the access-controlled MaxPlayers write, so it is folded into that operation.
The local fee value only determines the amounts of the outgoing transfers, so it is folded into the winner transfer operation.
Parameter _a exists solely as an operand of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter _b exists solely as an operand of SafeMath.mul.
Local c only holds the SafeMath.mul result.
